lines.text: Astra: a tapped poster flies in whole and stays the same picture. No blink, and no swap to other artwork.
The player, menus, stream list and toasts no longer stutter: the movement starts first, the heavy work after.
The hero's button always opens the title you tapped, even if the hero was turning at that moment.
The feel report now shows your screen's refresh rate and leaves out the noise from ordinary taps.
